text: Nascent regulatory sandbox frameworks for AI in Israel presents the following source proposition: Drawing from policy white papers, legislative materials, and implemented frameworks, it documents how Israel is adopting sector-specific regulatory sandboxes as experimental mechanisms to balance innovation with public interest concerns.
